articles.summary: HIGH POINT, N.C., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- vTv Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: VTVT), a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of cadisegliatin, a novel, potential first-in-class oral adjunctive therapy to insulin being investigated for the treatment of type 1 diabetes
articles.title: vTv Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
